data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for applying subtle stroke to a Text widget.
data.what_it_does: Adds a stroke or border to a standard Flutter Text widget. It wraps the text widget to provide customizable stroke widths and colors.
use_when: You need to display text with an outline or stroke effect
You want a single-purpose widget for text borders
avoid_when: You require advanced text formatting that is not supported by standard Text widgets
You do not need text strokes
strengths: Simple API wrapping standard Text widgets
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and Web
weaknesses: Limited to applying strokes on text widgets
